messages:
marta: Quick intake — customer asks: per-tenant routing + adaptive latency budget. Problem: some tenants need <200ms p95 for chat while others want lowest cost. We need a launch plan and clear acceptance criteria.
ajay: Question — do we expect different model variants per tenant or routing to same model with QoS?
marta: Prefer routing to different model variants (quantized vs full) + per-route QoS config. Non-goal: not building a full tenant billing UI in this phase.
devon: Edge case: what if a tenant sends bursty long-context requests? KV cache behavior could blow up latency. Need guardrails.
priya: UX note — config should be simple: a 3-option dropdown (latency | balanced | cost) + an advanced toggle. Don't surface raw batch/quant flags to customers.
ajay: Ops question — how do we enforce latency SLOs? Per-route circuit breaker + fallback to cheaper variant?
ops-bot: FYI: current runtime supports runtime routing rules and per-route timeouts. No per-tenant circuit breaker yet.
marta: Draft acceptance criteria (please react):
```
- AC1: Ability to assign a QoS profile to a tenant route (latency/balanced/cost) via API.
- AC2: p95 latency for "latency" profile <= 200ms on _typical_ 8k token pattern for 95% of requests in staging.
- AC3: Automatic fallback to compatible model variant when chosen model is unavailable, with <50ms added latency.
- AC4: Cost delta reporting per tenant for the first 30 days in Console (tokens + model variant breakdown).
- AC5: Runtime safety: burst protection prevents unbounded KV cache growth for any single tenant.
```
samir: Success metrics I'd track: % tenants using latency profile, median cost per 1k tokens by profile, rollback rate during 2-week trial.
devon: Edgecases: mixed convo (short prompts + long context) — we should add a QA script that simulates 10:1 short:long ratio. Also test cold-start with dedicated pool vs shared.
ajay: Implementation notes: need a routing policy object + rollout flags. I estimate 3 sprints for core runtime + 1 sprint for API + 1 for console surfaces.
priya: Non-goals restated: no multi-tenant billing changes, no global UI for tenant admin in this phase. Keep rollout API-only for early customers.
marta: Ask: owners — eng: @ajay, ml infra: @devon, design: @priya, success metrics/benching: @samir. Please confirm and I'll turn this into an RFC. :thumbsup:
ajay: confirmed. I'll slot initial spike to validate fallback latency before next planning.
devon: I'll draft QA harness for mixed convo ratios and KV pressure tests.
priya: I'll mock the minimal config UI and a CLI flow for early customers.
marta: Timeline proposal: spike (wk1), runtime work (wk2-5), API + console (wk6), canary with 3 tenants (wk7). If everyone ok I'll open RFC by EOD.
samir: +1 on timeline. Suggest we require canary to run 2 weeks with automated rollback triggers (error rate >2% or p95 > 300ms).
marta: Noted. I'll include rollback thresholds in RFC. Thanks all."
